source_text: 香奈小姐差不多想要了Ｅ～
translated_text: Kana-san, you're about ready for it, aren't you~
I'm going to put it in now~

source_text: 不要！我不想做送祥的事
translated_text: No! I don't want to do this kind of thing!

source_text: 那件事我会対隆史保密＂所以你放心咄
translated_text: I'll keep that matter a secret from Takashi, so rest assured.

source_text: 呵。感党真好。肋子也俄了～隆史也要回来了
translated_text: Ah. That felt really good. I'm getting hungry too~ Takashi will be home soon.
